Lis AGENTS.md, BRIEF.md, doc/11-assets-spec.md et assets/specs/batiment_aeroport_ar.json avant de travailler. La spécification versionnée fait foi.
Fichiers déjà présents : batiment_aeroport_ar_lod0.glb, batiment_aeroport_ar_lod1.glb, batiment_aeroport_ar_albedo.png, batiment_aeroport_ar_normale.png, batiment_aeroport_ar_rugosite.png, batiment_aeroport_ar_emission.png, batiment_aeroport_ar_masque_equipe.png. Inspecte-les avant toute modification.
Fichiers obligatoires manquants : aucun ; contrôler et améliorer le lot existant selon la demande.

Conserve les PNG externes partagés entre LOD, sans copie embarquée. Aucun nouvel asset régional ou national hors de cette commande. Pour un kit, conserve exactement la géométrie, les UV, les nœuds et les animations de la base.
Prépare le lot dans assets/livraisons/batiment_aeroport_ar/ puis lance npm run controler:asset -- --spec assets/specs/batiment_aeroport_ar.json --lot assets/livraisons/batiment_aeroport_ar. Corrige tous les refus avant intégration. Respecte les consignes du dépôt sur les contrôles visuels ; ne déclare jamais une approbation artistique automatique. CONTRAT COMPLET
You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

A rotorcraft pad on a one-metre plot: a circular concrete apron with a painted ring (a ring only, no letters), a low glazed control cabin on one side, a refuelling bowser, wind sock on a mast, and four ground lights at the cardinal points. Flat and open — nothing on it should be taller than the cabin. The cabin glazing and the four ground lights are emissive at night. It yields 1000 funds per day. National style of Argentine (Sky and white bands, hand-stitched leather, plain panels: plains equipment, long, low, kept like a blackboard reread before playing.): materials are flat matte paint, stitched leather, brushed steel and heavy canvas, finish fully matte and waxed, base colour #5fa8d8 with accents #f7f7f5, #2c3a4a. Biomes on its maps: plaine, montagne, neige. It is a capturable point: it changes owner during a match, so every surface that carries the team colour must be readable from directly above as well as from the default camera angle. Leave a clear flat approach on at least one side so a unit standing on the tile is never hidden.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; host-town architecture; warm lived-in details; emissive windows at night; regional building vernacular. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.92 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.45 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.92 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `batiment_aeroport_ar_lod0.glb` ≤ 4200 triangles, `batiment_aeroport_ar_lod1.glb` ≤ 1400 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_vitrage`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `toit`, `enseigne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `batiment_aeroport_ar_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Enduits, tuiles, bois et béton ; aucune enseigne lisible, aucun chiffre.), `batiment_aeroport_ar_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Joints de maçonnerie, bardages, tuiles, encadrements.), `batiment_aeroport_ar_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; Verre lisse, enduit mat, tuile poreuse : trois familles bien séparées.), `batiment_aeroport_ar_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, required; Fenêtres et lanterneaux éclairés : c’est ce qui fait la nuit du jeu.), `batiment_aeroport_ar_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 512×512, png, required; Stores, rives de toit, fanion : les surfaces qui prennent la nation.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (3200 ms, looping), `capture` (1400 ms), `touche` (400 ms, optional).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
capture: A restrained acknowledgement gesture; keep the footprint fixed.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

CONTRAT COMPLET
You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

A rotorcraft pad on a one-metre plot: a circular concrete apron with a painted ring (a ring only, no letters), a low glazed control cabin on one side, a refuelling bowser, wind sock on a mast, and four ground lights at the cardinal points. Flat and open — nothing on it should be taller than the cabin. The cabin glazing and the four ground lights are emissive at night. It yields 1000 funds per day. Regional style of Hauts-de-France (Dark red brick, bottle-green joinery, red estaminet floor tiles: warm inside, low outside.): roofs are a simple gable roof in clay tile, colour #8f4b3c; walls are fired earth, colour #a8503f, fully matte; the planting around it is bouleaux de terril with herbes hautes de plaine, foliage #6f8a55. Dress the plot with a dark spoil heap turned belvedere, a blank timber signboard, a worn stone bench and a thick living hedge, and with nothing else. It is a capturable point: it changes owner during a match, so every surface that carries the team colour must be readable from directly above as well as from the default camera angle. Leave a clear flat approach on at least one side so a unit standing on the tile is never hidden.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; host-town architecture; warm lived-in details; emissive windows at night; regional building vernacular. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.92 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.45 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.92 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `batiment_aeroport_fr_hauts_de_france_lod0.glb` ≤ 4200 triangles, `batiment_aeroport_fr_hauts_de_france_lod1.glb` ≤ 1400 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_vitrage`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `toit`, `enseigne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `batiment_aeroport_fr_hauts_de_france_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Enduits, tuiles, bois et béton ; aucune enseigne lisible, aucun chiffre.), `batiment_aeroport_fr_hauts_de_france_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Joints de maçonnerie, bardages, tuiles, encadrements.), `batiment_aeroport_fr_hauts_de_france_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; Verre lisse, enduit mat, tuile poreuse : trois familles bien séparées.), `batiment_aeroport_fr_hauts_de_france_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, required; Fenêtres et lanterneaux éclairés : c’est ce qui fait la nuit du jeu.), `batiment_aeroport_fr_hauts_de_france_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 512×512, png, required; Stores, rives de toit, fanion : les surfaces qui prennent la nation.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (3200 ms, looping), `capture` (1400 ms), `touche` (400 ms, optional).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
capture: A restrained acknowledgement gesture; keep the footprint fixed.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

CONTRAT COMPLET
You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

A team headquarters pavilion on a one-metre plot: a two-storey timber and glass building with a deep overhanging roof, an open first-floor balcony where the commander watches the field, a broad entrance canopy, and a tall bare flagpole with a plain unmarked pennant. It must be the most distinctive building on the board at a glance — taller, warmer, better lit. Roof edge, canopy and pennant are the team-colour zones. It yields 1000 funds per day. Regional style of Centre-Val de Loire (Near-white tuffeau, blue slate on tall roofs, fine ironwork: the most groomed style of the qualification.): roofs are a hipped roof on four sides in split slate, colour #4d5866; walls are dry-laid stone, colour #efe9d8, varnished; the planting around it is chênes de forêt de chasse with vignes en cordon, foliage #5f8a46. Dress the plot with a dry stone wall, a row of trained vines, a small dovecote and a bandstand kiosk, and with nothing else. It is a capturable point: it changes owner during a match, so every surface that carries the team colour must be readable from directly above as well as from the default camera angle. Leave a clear flat approach on at least one side so a unit standing on the tile is never hidden.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; host-town architecture; warm lived-in details; emissive windows at night; regional building vernacular. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.85 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.95 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `batiment_qg_fr_centre_val_de_loire_lod0.glb` ≤ 6500 triangles, `batiment_qg_fr_centre_val_de_loire_lod1.glb` ≤ 2100 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_vitrage`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `toit`, `enseigne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `batiment_qg_fr_centre_val_de_loire_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Enduits, tuiles, bois et béton ; aucune enseigne lisible, aucun chiffre.), `batiment_qg_fr_centre_val_de_loire_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Joints de maçonnerie, bardages, tuiles, encadrements.), `batiment_qg_fr_centre_val_de_loire_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; Verre lisse, enduit mat, tuile poreuse : trois familles bien séparées.), `batiment_qg_fr_centre_val_de_loire_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, required; Fenêtres et lanterneaux éclairés : c’est ce qui fait la nuit du jeu.), `batiment_qg_fr_centre_val_de_loire_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 512×512, png, required; Stores, rives de toit, fanion : les surfaces qui prennent la nation.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (3200 ms, looping), `capture` (1400 ms), `touche` (400 ms, optional).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
capture: A restrained acknowledgement gesture; keep the footprint fixed.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

National style of Suisse (Watchmaking precision: brushed steel, red and white, clean lines, nothing protruding and not a single missing screw.): materials are brushed steel, flat matte paint, planed timber, stitched leather and polished brass fittings, finish brushed in one direction and fully matte, base colour #c0392f with accents #e8e8e6, #c9a227. Biomes on its maps: montagne, foret, neige. It is a capturable point: it changes owner during a match, so every surface that carries the team colour must be readable from directly above as well as from the default camera angle. Leave a clear flat approach on at least one side so a unit standing on the tile is never hidden.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; host-town architecture; warm lived-in details; emissive windows at night; regional building vernacular. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.85 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.7 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `batiment_radar_ch_lod0.glb` ≤ 5000 triangles, `batiment_radar_ch_lod1.glb` ≤ 1600 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_vitrage`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `toit`, `enseigne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `batiment_radar_ch_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Enduits, tuiles, bois et béton ; aucune enseigne lisible, aucun chiffre.), `batiment_radar_ch_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Joints de maçonnerie, bardages, tuiles, encadrements.), `batiment_radar_ch_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; Verre lisse, enduit mat, tuile poreuse : trois familles bien séparées.), `batiment_radar_ch_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, required; Fenêtres et lanterneaux éclairés : c’est ce qui fait la nuit du jeu.), `batiment_radar_ch_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 512×512, png, required; Stores, rives de toit, fanion : les surfaces qui prennent la nation.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.

The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
capture: A restrained acknowledgement gesture; keep the footprint fixed.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

The archetype is worn by two or three different nations, so the face must stay culturally neutral and the outfit unbranded — the nation is expressed by the team-colour mask on the jacket and collar, nothing else.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.

Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no exaggerated caricature; no military uniform or rank insignia.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `commandant_fonceuse_lod0.glb` ≤ 14000 triangles.

## What it is

A single tree for the "cotier" biome as it grows in Bretagne: a salt-pruned maritime pine leaning inland, its canopy sheared flat on the seaward side. Regional style of Bretagne (Blue slate, pale granite, repainted boat timber: everything here is low, stocky and set against the wind.): roofs are a simple gable roof in split slate, colour #4a5560; walls are dry-laid stone, colour #b9b2a6, fully matte; the planting around it is ajoncs et bruyère rase with pins couchés par le vent, foliage #6f8a4a. Dress the plot with a dry stone wall, fishing nets hung to dry, a line of standing stones and a plain wayside marker cross, and with nothing else. It is instanced hundreds of times per map, so it must look good from every side and never show a face that identifies it as the same model. Model the trunk and the foliage as two separate named nodes; foliage uses alpha-tested cards clustered into three or four dense clumps, never a single flat billboard. Keep the crown clear of the tile edges so it does not overhang a neighbouring unit.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; instanced vegetation; alpha-tested foliage clusters; seasonal foliage variants; regional planting. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.55 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.62 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.55 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `decor_arbre_cotier_fr_bretagne_lod0.glb` ≤ 2500 triangles, `decor_arbre_cotier_fr_bretagne_lod1.glb` ≤ 700 triangles, `decor_arbre_cotier_fr_bretagne_lod2.glb` ≤ 180 triangles.
At most 2 materials, named exactly: `mat_ecorce`, `mat_feuillage`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `tronc`, `feuillage`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `decor_arbre_cotier_fr_bretagne_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Écorce et feuillage sur un seul atlas ; canal alpha net, sans halo.), `decor_arbre_cotier_fr_bretagne_normale.png` (normale, 512×512, png, required; Nervures des feuilles et relief d’écorce.), `decor_arbre_cotier_fr_bretagne_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; Feuille cireuse contre écorce sèche : deux valeurs franchement séparées.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.

Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (3600 ms, looping).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What it is

A single tree for the "jungle" biome as it grows in Madagascar: a buttressed rainforest tree with plank roots, a straight bare trunk and a dense crown overhanging on one side, with a liana loop. National style of Madagascar (Bush taxi: loaded roof rack, painted stickers, red laterite up to the windows, and salvaged timber wherever steel is missing.): materials are high-gloss paint, planed timber, heavy canvas, painted steel plate and woven rattan, finish dust-laden on the lower third and sun-faded, base colour #c14b2f with accents #e2c341, #2f7d4f. Biomes on its maps: jungle, montagne, cotier, foret. It is instanced hundreds of times per map, so it must look good from every side and never show a face that identifies it as the same model. Model the trunk and the foliage as two separate named nodes; foliage uses alpha-tested cards clustered into three or four dense clumps, never a single flat billboard. Keep the crown clear of the tile edges so it does not overhang a neighbouring unit.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; instanced vegetation; alpha-tested foliage clusters; seasonal foliage variants; regional planting. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.55 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.62 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.55 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `decor_arbre_jungle_mg_lod0.glb` ≤ 2500 triangles, `decor_arbre_jungle_mg_lod1.glb` ≤ 700 triangles, `decor_arbre_jungle_mg_lod2.glb` ≤ 180 triangles.
At most 2 materials, named exactly: `mat_ecorce`, `mat_feuillage`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `tronc`, `feuillage`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `decor_arbre_jungle_mg_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Écorce et feuillage sur un seul atlas ; canal alpha net, sans halo.), `decor_arbre_jungle_mg_normale.png` (normale, 512×512, png, required; Nervures des feuilles et relief d’écorce.), `decor_arbre_jungle_mg_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; Feuille cireuse contre écorce sèche : deux valeurs franchement séparées.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (3600 ms, looping).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 3 levels of detail, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Regional style of Occitanie (Orange barrel tile, blond causse stone, lavender-blue shutters, and plane-tree shade painted into the roughness.): roofs are a shallow-pitched roof in clay tile, colour #c07a45; walls are dry-laid stone, colour #e3d3b4, sand-blasted to a dead matte; the planting around it is platanes du canal with chênes verts de garrigue, foliage #6f8a4f. Dress the plot with a dry stone wall, a bandstand kiosk, a worn stone bench and a shepherd’s stone shelter, and with nothing else. It is instanced hundreds of times per map, so it must look good from every side and never show a face that identifies it as the same model. Model the trunk and the foliage as two separate named nodes; foliage uses alpha-tested cards clustered into three or four dense clumps, never a single flat billboard. Keep the crown clear of the tile edges so it does not overhang a neighbouring unit.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; instanced vegetation; alpha-tested foliage clusters; seasonal foliage variants; regional planting. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.55 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.62 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.55 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `decor_arbre_montagne_fr_occitanie_lod0.glb` ≤ 2500 triangles, `decor_arbre_montagne_fr_occitanie_lod1.glb` ≤ 700 triangles, `decor_arbre_montagne_fr_occitanie_lod2.glb` ≤ 180 triangles.
At most 2 materials, named exactly: `mat_ecorce`, `mat_feuillage`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `tronc`, `feuillage`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `decor_arbre_montagne_fr_occitanie_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Écorce et feuillage sur un seul atlas ; canal alpha net, sans halo.), `decor_arbre_montagne_fr_occitanie_normale.png` (normale, 512×512, png, required; Nervures des feuilles et relief d’écorce.), `decor_arbre_montagne_fr_occitanie_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; Feuille cireuse contre écorce sèche : deux valeurs franchement séparées.).

National style of Mongolie (Felt and dust: long chassis wrapped in strapped raw felt, deel orange on the facings, and a layer of steppe over the lower third.): materials are thick felt, flat matte paint, stitched leather, planed timber and braided rope, finish dust-laden on the lower third and fully matte, base colour #e08a1e with accents #c0392f, #f0e6d2. Biomes on its maps: plaine, desert, montagne. It is instanced hundreds of times per map, so it must look good from every side and never show a face that identifies it as the same model. Model the trunk and the foliage as two separate named nodes; foliage uses alpha-tested cards clustered into three or four dense clumps, never a single flat billboard. Keep the crown clear of the tile edges so it does not overhang a neighbouring unit.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; instanced vegetation; alpha-tested foliage clusters; seasonal foliage variants; regional planting. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.55 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.62 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.55 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `decor_arbre_plaine_mn_lod0.glb` ≤ 2500 triangles, `decor_arbre_plaine_mn_lod1.glb` ≤ 700 triangles, `decor_arbre_plaine_mn_lod2.glb` ≤ 180 triangles.
At most 2 materials, named exactly: `mat_ecorce`, `mat_feuillage`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `tronc`, `feuillage`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `decor_arbre_plaine_mn_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Écorce et feuillage sur un seul atlas ; canal alpha net, sans halo.), `decor_arbre_plaine_mn_normale.png` (normale, 512×512, png, required; Nervures des feuilles et relief d’écorce.), `decor_arbre_plaine_mn_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; Feuille cireuse contre écorce sèche : deux valeurs franchement séparées.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion use linear data. The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (3600 ms, looping).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

node names, material names, the 3 levels of detail, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Regional style of La Réunion (Highland house in pale shingles, blue-grey sheet roofing, raw black rock wherever the flow has been.): roofs are a hipped roof on four sides in corrugated sheet, colour #4a5f6b; walls are planed timber, colour #f0e6cf, varnished; the planting around it is cannes en escalier with tamarins des hauts, foliage #3f7a4a. Dress the plot with stepped garden terraces, a block of cane in regular bands, a hut on stilts and a worn stone bench, and with nothing else. It is instanced hundreds of times per map, so it must look good from every side and never show a face that identifies it as the same model. Model the trunk and the foliage as two separate named nodes; foliage uses alpha-tested cards clustered into three or four dense clumps, never a single flat billboard. Keep the crown clear of the tile edges so it does not overhang a neighbouring unit.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm.

Bounding box 0.45 m (± 0.08) wide, 0.3 m (± 0.08) tall, 0.45 m (± 0.08) deep.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Drone ravitailleur" in the colours and materials of Argentine. Guiding line: Sky and white bands, hand-stitched leather, plain panels: plains equipment, long, low, kept like a blackboard reread before playing. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_drone_ravitailleur_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #5fa8d8, dark paint #28607f, light paint #dcf0fa, accents #f7f7f5, #2c3a4a. Materials to read at a glance: flat matte paint, stitched leather, brushed steel and heavy canvas. Finish: fully matte and waxed. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stitched side pannier, a coil of rope on a cleat and a whip antenna on a base spring. Abstract decals only: horizontal bands in #f7f7f5 on the flanc. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries horizontal bands, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.9 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.65 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.9 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, at the flight height specified in the description; keep the footprint origin on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_ar_drone_ravitailleur_lod0.glb` ≤ 3500 triangles, `kit_ar_drone_ravitailleur_lod1.glb` ≤ 1200 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_grue`, `module_nacelle`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_ar_drone_ravitailleur_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_ar_drone_ravitailleur_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_ar_drone_ravitailleur_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_ar_drone_ravitailleur_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_ar_drone_ravitailleur_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_ar_drone_ravitailleur_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

## What it is

National kit for "Artillerie" in the colours and materials of Brésil. Guiding line: Trio elétrico: large green and yellow painted surfaces, garlands, strapped loudspeakers, and bodywork built to be looked at from a stand. Pigment palette: base #2f9d5b, dark paint #146336, light paint #c9f0d8, accents #e2c341, #2c4a86. ## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.

Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_br_artillerie_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_br_artillerie_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.

## Textures

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.

Node racine; parent scene; local pivot [0, 0, 0] metres; Footprint origin; never animated.
Node base; parent racine; local pivot [0, 0, 0] metres; Track runs, pads and road wheels.
Node corps; parent racine; local pivot [0, 0.16, 0] metres; Flat deck, raised front cab, folded side ladder, travel lock.
Node module_canon_long; parent corps; local pivot [0, 0.155, -0.13] metres; Open cradle and long marker tube, elevation around local X. No turret or armour.
Node socle; parent racine; local pivot [0, 0.185, -0.28] metres; Both rear ground spades, folding together around local X; not a pedestal.

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Raise both spades, lower the tube onto the travel lock; restrained suspension motion, loop without a jump.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Guiding line: Trio elétrico: large green and yellow painted surfaces, garlands, strapped loudspeakers, and bodywork built to be looked at from a stand. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_brouilleur_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2f9d5b, dark paint #146336, light paint #c9f0d8, accents #e2c341, #2c4a86. Materials to read at a glance: high-gloss paint, painted steel plate, heavy canvas, bare aluminium and clear glazing. Finish: glossy and lacquered. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a string of small hanging pennant lights, a plain unlettered banner, a blank instruction plate and a stretched canvas roof. Abstract decals only: a broad spiral in #e2c341 on the flanc; a wave frieze in #2c4a86 on the jupe. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a broad spiral, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_br_brouilleur_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_br_brouilleur_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_radar`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_br_brouilleur_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_br_brouilleur_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_br_brouilleur_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_br_brouilleur_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_br_brouilleur_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_br_brouilleur_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Infanterie" in the colours and materials of Brésil. Guiding line: Trio elétrico: large green and yellow painted surfaces, garlands, strapped loudspeakers, and bodywork built to be looked at from a stand. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_infanterie_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2f9d5b, dark paint #146336, light paint #c9f0d8, accents #e2c341, #2c4a86. Materials to read at a glance: high-gloss paint, painted steel plate, heavy canvas, bare aluminium and clear glazing. Finish: glossy and lacquered. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a string of small hanging pennant lights, a plain unlettered banner, a blank instruction plate and a stretched canvas roof. Abstract decals only: a broad spiral in #e2c341 on the flanc; a wave frieze in #2c4a86 on the jupe. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a broad spiral, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.45 m (± 0.06) wide, 0.6 m (± 0.06) tall, 0.45 m (± 0.06) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_br_infanterie_lod0.glb` ≤ 4000 triangles, `kit_br_infanterie_lod1.glb` ≤ 1400 triangles.
At most 2 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_br_infanterie_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_br_infanterie_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_br_infanterie_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_br_infanterie_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_br_infanterie_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms), `capture` (1300 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
capture: A restrained acknowledgement gesture; keep the footprint fixed.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. ## Textures

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.
