You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Recon" in the colours and materials of Canada. Guiding line: Deep-cold equipment: matte red and white, thick strapped tarpaulins, jerrycans in a row, and a crust of salt and slush along the lower body. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_recon_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #c0392f, dark paint #742019, light paint #f4d2ce, accents #f2f0ea, #2c3a4a. Materials to read at a glance: flat matte paint, heavy canvas, painted steel plate, planed timber and dusty rubber. Finish: dusted with dried salt and fully matte. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a row of strapped jerrycans, a rolled tarpaulin along the fender, a front winch with a hook and a ski and pole rack. Abstract decals only: a cross-hatch in #f2f0ea on the toit. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a cross-hatch, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.5 m (± 0.06) wide, 0.4 m (± 0.06) tall, 0.7 m (± 0.06) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_ca_recon_lod0.glb` ≤ 3500 triangles, `kit_ca_recon_lod1.glb` ≤ 1200 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_radar`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_ca_recon_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_ca_recon_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_ca_recon_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_ca_recon_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_ca_recon_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_ca_recon_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Sous-marin" in the colours and materials of Suisse. Guiding line: Watchmaking precision: brushed steel, red and white, clean lines, nothing protruding and not a single missing screw. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_sous_marin_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #c0392f, dark paint #7d2019, light paint #f0d2cd, accents #e8e8e6, #c9a227. Materials to read at a glance: brushed steel, flat matte paint, planed timber, stitched leather and polished brass fittings. Finish: brushed in one direction and fully matte. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a ski and pole rack, a coil of rope on a cleat and a blank instruction plate. Abstract decals only: a diagonal cross in #e8e8e6 on the toit; a sawtooth line in #c9a227 on the jupe. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a diagonal cross, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_ch_sous_marin_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_ch_sous_marin_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_ch_sous_marin_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_ch_sous_marin_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_ch_sous_marin_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_ch_sous_marin_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_ch_sous_marin_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Bounding box 0.95 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.45 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.09) deep.

At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.

## What it is

National kit for "Drone ravitailleur" in the colours and materials of Fidji. Guiding line: Catamaran hull: pale turquoise, oiled outrigger timber, braided ropes, printed cloth stretched as a sun shade, and nothing that does not float. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_drone_ravitailleur_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2fa0b8, dark paint #12606f, light paint #c6eef5, accents #f2e2b8, #2f8f5f. Materials to read at a glance: planed timber, satin paint, braided rope, heavy canvas and woven rattan. Finish: oiled and sun-faded. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a fringed sun visor, a coil of rope on a cleat and a knotted net stowed on the deck. Abstract decals only: half-moons in #f2e2b8 on the flanc. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries half-moons, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.9 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.65 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.9 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, at the flight height specified in the description; keep the footprint origin on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_fj_drone_ravitailleur_lod0.glb` ≤ 3500 triangles, `kit_fj_drone_ravitailleur_lod1.glb` ≤ 1200 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_grue`, `module_nacelle`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_fj_drone_ravitailleur_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_fj_drone_ravitailleur_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_fj_drone_ravitailleur_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_fj_drone_ravitailleur_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_fj_drone_ravitailleur_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_fj_drone_ravitailleur_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). ## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_helico_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2fa0b8, dark paint #12606f, light paint #c6eef5, accents #f2e2b8, #2f8f5f. Materials to read at a glance: planed timber, satin paint, braided rope, heavy canvas and woven rattan. Finish: oiled and sun-faded. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a fringed sun visor, a coil of rope on a cleat and a knotted net stowed on the deck. Abstract decals only: half-moons in #f2e2b8 on the flanc. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries half-moons, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.9 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.65 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.9 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, at the flight height specified in the description; keep the footprint origin on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_fj_helico_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_fj_helico_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_nacelle`.

## Textures

Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

National kit for "Char léger" in the colours and materials of France. Guiding line: The French school: matte blue panels, crisp piping, kit stowed a little too neatly and varnished a little too proudly — the elegance of a team that has not won anything yet. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_char_leger_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2f5fd0, dark paint #1b3a86, light paint #8fb2f2, accents #c8324a, #f4f6fb. Materials to read at a glance: flat matte paint, brushed steel, heavy canvas, stitched leather and varnished wood. Finish: fully matte and satin. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a small plain pennant, a stitched side pannier and a whip antenna on a base spring. Abstract decals only: oblique stripes in #c8324a on the flanc; nested squares in #f4f6fb on the capot. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries oblique stripes, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_fr_char_leger_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_fr_char_leger_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_tourelle`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_fr_char_leger_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_fr_char_leger_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_fr_char_leger_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_fr_char_leger_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_fr_char_leger_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

CONTRAT COMPLET
You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Méca" in the colours and materials of France. Guiding line: The French school: matte blue panels, crisp piping, kit stowed a little too neatly and varnished a little too proudly — the elegance of a team that has not won anything yet. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_meca_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2f5fd0, dark paint #1b3a86, light paint #8fb2f2, accents #c8324a, #f4f6fb. Materials to read at a glance: flat matte paint, brushed steel, heavy canvas, stitched leather and varnished wood. Finish: fully matte and satin. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a small plain pennant, a stitched side pannier and a whip antenna on a base spring. Abstract decals only: oblique stripes in #c8324a on the flanc; nested squares in #f4f6fb on the capot. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries oblique stripes, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.45 m (± 0.06) wide, 0.6 m (± 0.06) tall, 0.45 m (± 0.06) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_fr_meca_lod0.glb` ≤ 4000 triangles, `kit_fr_meca_lod1.glb` ≤ 1400 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_lance_roquettes`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_fr_meca_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_fr_meca_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_fr_meca_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_fr_meca_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_fr_meca_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms), `capture` (1300 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
capture: A restrained acknowledgement gesture; keep the footprint fixed.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Lance-roquettes" in the colours and materials of Grèce. Guiding line: Painted caique timber: strong blue over pale wood, coiled ropes, rolled tarpaulins, and paint reapplied every year over the same flake. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_roquettes_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2e78bf, dark paint #17456f, light paint #dcecf8, accents #f7f9fb, #d8c9a0. Materials to read at a glance: planed timber, high-gloss paint, braided rope, heavy canvas and polished brass fittings. Finish: sun-faded and glossy. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a coil of rope on a cleat, a rolled tarpaulin along the fender, a small hooded lantern and a knotted net stowed on the deck. Abstract decals only: a wave frieze in #f7f9fb on the flanc. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a wave frieze, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.7 m (± 0.08) wide, 0.58 m (± 0.08) tall, 0.95 m (± 0.08) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_gr_roquettes_lod0.glb` ≤ 9000 triangles, `kit_gr_roquettes_lod1.glb` ≤ 3000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_lance_roquettes`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_gr_roquettes_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_gr_roquettes_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_gr_roquettes_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_gr_roquettes_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_gr_roquettes_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Drone marin" in the colours and materials of Indonésie. Guiding line: Colourful ferry hulls: wide hand-painted bands, varnished wood, strapped bamboo, and paint that turns under an equatorial sun. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_drone_marin_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #c8443c, dark paint #7a221d, light paint #f6d3d0, accents #2f8f7f, #f2e2b8. Materials to read at a glance: high-gloss paint, varnished wood, strapped bamboo, heavy canvas and woven rattan. Finish: glossy and sun-faded. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stretched canvas roof, a knotted net stowed on the deck, a coil of rope on a cleat and a small hooded lantern. Abstract decals only: overlapping scales in #2f8f7f on the flanc; dashed bands in #f2e2b8 on the toit. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries overlapping scales, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.5 m (± 0.06) wide, 0.4 m (± 0.06) tall, 0.7 m (± 0.06) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_id_drone_marin_lod0.glb` ≤ 3500 triangles, `kit_id_drone_marin_lod1.glb` ≤ 1200 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_radar`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_id_drone_marin_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_id_drone_marin_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_id_drone_marin_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_id_drone_marin_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_id_drone_marin_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_id_drone_marin_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_genie_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #c8443c, dark paint #7a221d, light paint #f6d3d0, accents #2f8f7f, #f2e2b8. Materials to read at a glance: high-gloss paint, varnished wood, strapped bamboo, heavy canvas and woven rattan. Finish: glossy and sun-faded. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stretched canvas roof, a knotted net stowed on the deck, a coil of rope on a cleat and a small hooded lantern. Abstract decals only: overlapping scales in #2f8f7f on the flanc; dashed bands in #f2e2b8 on the toit. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries overlapping scales, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.45 m (± 0.06) wide, 0.6 m (± 0.06) tall, 0.45 m (± 0.06) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_id_genie_lod0.glb` ≤ 4000 triangles, `kit_id_genie_lod1.glb` ≤ 1400 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_radar`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_id_genie_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_id_genie_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_id_genie_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_id_genie_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_id_genie_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_id_genie_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

## What it is

National kit for "Brouilleur mobile" in the colours and materials of Inde. Guiding line: Painted lorry: every flat surface is a decorated panel, garlands hung everywhere, mirrors sewn onto the canvas, and nothing discreet anywhere. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_brouilleur_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #e2842a, dark paint #8f4d0d, light paint #ffe0b8, accents #2f7d4f, #f2c4d8. Materials to read at a glance: high-gloss paint, heavy canvas, painted steel plate, planed timber and enamelled panel. Finish: glossy and lacquered. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a string of small hanging pennant lights, a stretched canvas roof, a blank instruction plate and a small mounted bell. Abstract decals only: dots in #f2c4d8 on the portiere; a repeated arrowhead in #2f7d4f on the arriere. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries dots, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_in_brouilleur_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_in_brouilleur_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_radar`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_in_brouilleur_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_in_brouilleur_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_in_brouilleur_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_in_brouilleur_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_in_brouilleur_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_in_brouilleur_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a string of small hanging pennant lights, a stretched canvas roof, a blank instruction plate and a small mounted bell. Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Lance-missiles sol-air" in the colours and materials of Islande. Guiding line: Black rock and steam: basalt-grey paint scoured by salt, oversized lamps, and a red edge you can see a kilometre off in the mist. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_missiles_air_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #5b6f86, dark paint #2c3a4a, light paint #c2d6e6, accents #c04a52, #e8eef3. Materials to read at a glance: flat matte paint, painted steel plate, dusty rubber and oilcloth. Finish: dusted with dried salt and fully matte. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a whip antenna on a base spring, a row of strapped jerrycans, a spare wheel on the flank and a front winch with a hook. Abstract decals only: a zigzag in #c04a52 on the flanc. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a zigzag, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.7 m (± 0.08) wide, 0.58 m (± 0.08) tall, 0.95 m (± 0.08) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_is_missiles_air_lod0.glb` ≤ 9000 triangles, `kit_is_missiles_air_lod1.glb` ≤ 3000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_lance_roquettes`, `module_radar`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_is_missiles_air_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_is_missiles_air_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_is_missiles_air_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_is_missiles_air_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_is_missiles_air_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_is_missiles_air_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.
