You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Chasseur" in the colours and materials of Japon. Guiding line: Trainset white and platform grey: smooth surfaces, even panel gaps, a single pink pinstripe, and a cleanliness you notice before the colour. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_chasseur_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #d05a6e, dark paint #7d2b3c, light paint #f7dbe1, accents #f7f7f5, #2c3a4a. Materials to read at a glance: satin paint, bare aluminium, clear glazing, heavy canvas and glazed ceramic. Finish: satin and lacquered. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a blank instruction plate, a whip antenna on a base spring and a stitched side pannier. Abstract decals only: concentric rings in #d05a6e on the nez; horizontal bands in #2c3a4a on the jupe. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries concentric rings, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.95 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.45 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, at the flight height specified in the description; keep the footprint origin on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_jp_chasseur_lod0.glb` ≤ 9000 triangles, `kit_jp_chasseur_lod1.glb` ≤ 3000 triangles.
At most 2 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_jp_chasseur_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_jp_chasseur_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_jp_chasseur_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_jp_chasseur_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_jp_chasseur_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Drone d’observation" in the colours and materials of Kenya. Guiding line: Racing kit: light equipment, bare aluminium, thin straps, taut canvas bibs, and nothing heavier than it needs to be. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_drone_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2f7d4f, dark paint #164d2e, light paint #c6e8d2, accents #c0392f, #f2f0e6. Materials to read at a glance: bare aluminium, heavy canvas, flat matte paint and dusty rubber. Finish: fully matte and brushed in one direction. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a felt-covered flask, a stitched side pannier and a whip antenna on a base spring. Abstract decals only: vertical stripes in #c0392f on the flanc. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries vertical stripes, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.9 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.65 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.9 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, at the flight height specified in the description; keep the footprint origin on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_ke_drone_lod0.glb` ≤ 3500 triangles, `kit_ke_drone_lod1.glb` ≤ 1200 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_ke_drone_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_ke_drone_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_ke_drone_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_ke_drone_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_ke_drone_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.

## What it is

National kit for "Sous-marin" in the colours and materials of Maroc. Guiding line: Tarpaulined convoy: thick canvas with red and blue diamonds, stitched leather, brass from the tea service, and sand in every joint. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_sous_marin_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #b0402f, dark paint #6b2117, light paint #f0cdc2, accents #2f7d4f, #e8c98a. Materials to read at a glance: heavy canvas, stitched leather, polished brass fittings, flat matte paint and planed timber. Finish: dust-laden on the lower third and fully matte. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stretched canvas roof, sand ladders on the flank, a hanging water can and a rolled patterned rug. Abstract decals only: diamonds in #e8c98a on the flanc; tight hatching in #2f7d4f on the capot. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries diamonds, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_ma_sous_marin_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_ma_sous_marin_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_ma_sous_marin_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_ma_sous_marin_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_ma_sous_marin_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_ma_sous_marin_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_ma_sous_marin_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Drone ravitailleur" in the colours and materials of Madagascar. Guiding line: Bush taxi: loaded roof rack, painted stickers, red laterite up to the windows, and salvaged timber wherever steel is missing. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_drone_ravitailleur_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #c14b2f, dark paint #742616, light paint #f3d0c4, accents #e2c341, #2f7d4f. Materials to read at a glance: high-gloss paint, planed timber, heavy canvas, painted steel plate and woven rattan. Finish: dust-laden on the lower third and sun-faded. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a loaded roof rack, a rolled tarpaulin along the fender, a coil of rope on a cleat and a row of strapped jerrycans. Abstract decals only: tight hatching in #e2c341 on the flanc; a cross-hatch in #2f7d4f on the toit. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries tight hatching, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.9 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.65 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.9 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, at the flight height specified in the description; keep the footprint origin on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_mg_drone_ravitailleur_lod0.glb` ≤ 3500 triangles, `kit_mg_drone_ravitailleur_lod1.glb` ≤ 1200 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_grue`, `module_nacelle`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_mg_drone_ravitailleur_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_mg_drone_ravitailleur_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_mg_drone_ravitailleur_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_mg_drone_ravitailleur_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_mg_drone_ravitailleur_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_mg_drone_ravitailleur_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Pigment palette: base #e08a1e, dark paint #8c4d08, light paint #ffdda6, accents #c0392f, #f0e6d2. Materials to read at a glance: thick felt, flat matte paint, stitched leather, planed timber and braided rope. Finish: dust-laden on the lower third and fully matte. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stitched side pannier, a coil of rope on a cleat, a felt-covered flask and a hanging water can. Abstract decals only: a run of arcs in #c0392f on the flanc. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a run of arcs, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Méca" in the colours and materials of Mongolie. Guiding line: Felt and dust: long chassis wrapped in strapped raw felt, deel orange on the facings, and a layer of steppe over the lower third. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_meca_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #e08a1e, dark paint #8c4d08, light paint #ffdda6, accents #c0392f, #f0e6d2. Materials to read at a glance: thick felt, flat matte paint, stitched leather, planed timber and braided rope. Finish: dust-laden on the lower third and fully matte. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stitched side pannier, a coil of rope on a cleat, a felt-covered flask and a hanging water can. Abstract decals only: a run of arcs in #c0392f on the flanc. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a run of arcs, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.45 m (± 0.06) wide, 0.6 m (± 0.06) tall, 0.45 m (± 0.06) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_mn_meca_lod0.glb` ≤ 4000 triangles, `kit_mn_meca_lod1.glb` ≤ 1400 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_lance_roquettes`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_mn_meca_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_mn_meca_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_mn_meca_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_mn_meca_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_mn_meca_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms), `capture` (1300 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
capture: A restrained acknowledgement gesture; keep the footprint fixed.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Char moyen" in the colours and materials of Mexique. Guiding line: Entrance with a brass band: strong green, gold piping stitched like a cape, loud chrome, and a fringed sun visor over the windscreen. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_char_moyen_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2f8f5f, dark paint #155c39, light paint #c9edd9, accents #e2c341, #c0392f. Materials to read at a glance: high-gloss paint, polished brass fittings, stitched leather, heavy canvas and enamelled panel. Finish: glossy and lacquered. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a fringed sun visor, a string of small hanging pennant lights, a plain unlettered banner and a small mounted bell. Abstract decals only: four-pointed stars in #e2c341 on the capot; a zigzag in #c0392f on the jupe. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries four-pointed stars, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_mx_char_moyen_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_mx_char_moyen_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_tourelle`, `module_canon_long`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_mx_char_moyen_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_mx_char_moyen_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_mx_char_moyen_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_mx_char_moyen_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_mx_char_moyen_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `tir` (700 ms), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Drone d’observation" in the colours and materials of Népal. Guiding line: Everything is carried: small volumes, straps everywhere, crimson and deep blue oilcloth, and not one useless gram. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_drone_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #b8443f, dark paint #6d1f1d, light paint #f2cfcb, accents #2c4a86, #e8e2d0. Materials to read at a glance: oilcloth, stitched leather, braided rope, planed timber and flat matte paint. Finish: fully matte and sun-faded. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stitched side pannier, a coil of rope on a cleat, a felt-covered flask and a small plain pennant. Abstract decals only: a row of triangles in #2c4a86 on the epaule. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a row of triangles, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.9 m (± 0.09) wide, 0.65 m (± 0.09) tall, 0.9 m (± 0.09) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, at the flight height specified in the description; keep the footprint origin on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_np_drone_lod0.glb` ≤ 3500 triangles, `kit_np_drone_lod1.glb` ≤ 1200 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_np_drone_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_np_drone_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_np_drone_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_np_drone_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_np_drone_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

You are producing a game-ready 3D asset for a turn-based tactics game.
Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Drone marin" in the colours and materials of Nouvelle-Zélande. Guiding line: Wet-fern green: dark satin paint, short surfaces, plant camouflage netting, and water beading on everything all the time. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_drone_marin_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2f5f4f, dark paint #153b30, light paint #c6e3d8, accents #f2f0e6, #2c3a4a. Materials to read at a glance: satin paint, multi-tone plant camouflage, heavy canvas, dusty rubber and planed timber. Finish: satin and sun-faded. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a knotted net stowed on the deck, a low windbreak screen, a coil of rope on a cleat and a felt-covered flask. Abstract decals only: a repeated arrowhead in #f2f0e6 on the capot. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a repeated arrowhead, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.5 m (± 0.06) wide, 0.4 m (± 0.06) tall, 0.7 m (± 0.06) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_nz_drone_marin_lod0.glb` ≤ 3500 triangles, `kit_nz_drone_marin_lod1.glb` ≤ 1200 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_radar`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_nz_drone_marin_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_nz_drone_marin_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_nz_drone_marin_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_nz_drone_marin_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_nz_drone_marin_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_nz_drone_marin_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_genie_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #2f5f4f, dark paint #153b30, light paint #c6e3d8, accents #f2f0e6, #2c3a4a. Materials to read at a glance: satin paint, multi-tone plant camouflage, heavy canvas, dusty rubber and planed timber. Finish: satin and sun-faded. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a knotted net stowed on the deck, a low windbreak screen, a coil of rope on a cleat and a felt-covered flask. Abstract decals only: a repeated arrowhead in #f2f0e6 on the capot. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a repeated arrowhead, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.45 m (± 0.06) wide, 0.6 m (± 0.06) tall, 0.45 m (± 0.06) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_nz_genie_lod0.glb` ≤ 4000 triangles, `kit_nz_genie_lod1.glb` ≤ 1400 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_radar`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_nz_genie_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_nz_genie_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_nz_genie_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_nz_genie_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_nz_genie_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_nz_genie_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Follow every constraint below literally: an automatic check reads them back on delivery and refuses the file.

## What it is

National kit for "Brouilleur mobile" in the colours and materials of Pérou. Guiding line: Pack load: braided straps, wool pompoms at the corners, jointed timber, and red paint brushed onto metal that has already served. Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_brouilleur_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #c0392f, dark paint #722018, light paint #f2cec9, accents #e2c341, #2f7d8f. Materials to read at a glance: braided rope, planed timber, flat matte paint, stitched leather and thick felt. Finish: fully matte and patinated by use. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stitched side pannier, a coil of rope on a cleat, a felt-covered flask and a small plain pennant. Abstract decals only: a chequerboard in #e2c341 on the flanc; nested squares in #2f7d8f on the capot. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a chequerboard, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

## Size and pivot

Bounding box 0.62 m (± 0.07) wide, 0.5 m (± 0.07) tall, 0.85 m (± 0.07) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_pe_brouilleur_lod0.glb` ≤ 6000 triangles, `kit_pe_brouilleur_lod1.glb` ≤ 2000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_radar`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_pe_brouilleur_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_pe_brouilleur_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_pe_brouilleur_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_pe_brouilleur_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_pe_brouilleur_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.), `kit_pe_brouilleur_emission.png` (emission, 512×512, png, optional; Écrans et veilleuses, pour la phase de nuit.).
**No lighting and no shadow baked into the albedo** — the game lights the scene itself, and a painted shadow becomes a permanent one that contradicts the sun at every hour and every season.

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Use three silhouette anchors from the description. Check top, three-quarter and 65 degrees above the ground at 48 CSS pixels per metre. Fine surface grain must not replace readable geometry.
Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). The separate metal PNG remains the editable metal channel.
Each file must be at most 24 MiB; the complete delivery at most 96 MiB. Keep PNG textures external, shared by all LODs. Each GLB image URI must be the exact neighbouring filename, without a directory or data URI. Never embed duplicate PNG copies.
Deliver a candidate, then obtain human visual approval in the inspector. Technical acceptance alone never approves the art or proves that lighting was not baked into albedo.

The **team mask** is a crisp black-and-white image: white where the team colour will be applied, black on tracks, glass, rubber, metal and skin. Paint those masked zones **neutral grey** in the albedo, never in a nation colour.

## Animations

Clips named exactly: `repos` (2400 ms, looping), `deplacement` (1000 ms, looping), `touche` (500 ms), `hors_jeu` (900 ms).
repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.
hors_jeu: Settle the hull, park the equipment and hide the readiness indicator. Hold the final slump; never explode. Rigid node transforms cannot animate PBR emission: hide or fold the indicator instead.
For a rigid model these are node-transform animations. `hors_jeu` is a slump and a switch-off, never an explosion.

## What you will probably have to fix by hand afterwards

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.

Paint the delivered base mesh of unite_missiles_sol_base, unchanged: same geometry, same UV layout, same node names and animation clips. Pigment palette: base #c0392f, dark paint #722018, light paint #f2cec9, accents #e2c341, #2f7d8f. Materials to read at a glance: braided rope, planed timber, flat matte paint, stitched leather and thick felt. Finish: fully matte and patinated by use. Paint these ornament motifs into the existing UV layout, with normal-map detail only, and nothing else: a stitched side pannier, a coil of rope on a cleat, a felt-covered flask and a small plain pennant. Abstract decals only: a chequerboard in #e2c341 on the flanc; nested squares in #2f7d8f on the capot. No added nodes, geometry, baked shadows or painted highlights. For colour-blind readability an existing team-colour panel carries a chequerboard, unique to this nation. This is a full texture set, not a tinted mask: the albedo is painted for this nation alone. The only team mask left is a narrow band within the inherited team-colour panels, so two players of the same nation stay apart.

## Style

Stylised realism: real materials — painted sheet metal, matte technical fabric, washed concrete, worn wood, dusty rubber — on simple, readable volumes. Competition equipment kept in good repair, marked by use, never damaged by violence. Saturated colours, figurine proportions. The silhouette must stay recognisable from a 65° top-down camera at about 48 pixels per metre.

Art direction: Réaliste dans les matières, léger dans l’esprit. Materials: Matières crédibles et travaillées — tôle peinte griffée, tissu technique mat, béton lavé, bois usé, caoutchouc poussiéreux — sur des formes simples et lisibles. On sculpte du matériel de compétition bien entretenu, pas du matériel de guerre : propre, marqué par l’usage, jamais abîmé par la violence.
Keywords: stylised realism; clean readable silhouette; top-down tactics board; sports tournament equipment; physically based materials; national livery kit; hand-painted texture set; closed ornament vocabulary. Avoid: no readable text or numbers; no real-world insignia or flags; no grime of battle, no damage, no blood; no thin spikes or antennas under 2 cm; no tinted grey base coat pretending to be a livery.

Forbidden, without exception: no symboles reels, no drapeaux reels, no texte lisible, no sang, no marques deposees, no personnes reelles, no violence explicite. These are tournament athletes with marker launchers, not soldiers.

Bounding box 0.7 m (± 0.08) wide, 0.58 m (± 0.08) tall, 0.95 m (± 0.08) deep.
Origin: centre of the footprint, at ground level. Up axis **+Y**, front **+Z**, resting on the ground. 1 unit = 1 metre.

## Geometry and naming

glTF 2.0 binary (.glb), PBR metallic-roughness. One file per level of detail: `kit_pe_missiles_sol_lod0.glb` ≤ 9000 triangles, `kit_pe_missiles_sol_lod1.glb` ≤ 3000 triangles.
At most 3 materials, named exactly: `mat_corps`, `mat_details`.
Required nodes (unique names; additional skeleton bones allowed): `racine`, `corps`, `base`, `socle`, `module_lance_roquettes`, `module_antenne`.

## Textures

One file per channel, using the declared format: `kit_pe_missiles_sol_albedo.png` (albedo, 1024×1024, png, required; Peinture nationale complète : couleurs, matières et décalcomanies déjà en place.), `kit_pe_missiles_sol_normale.png` (normale, 1024×1024, png, required; Relief propre au kit : coutures, sangles, panneaux rapportés, grain des matières.), `kit_pe_missiles_sol_rugosite.png` (rugosite, 512×512, png, required; C’est elle qui sépare une peinture mate d’un acier brossé : prévoir du contraste.), `kit_pe_missiles_sol_metal.png` (metal, 512×512, png, optional; Seulement si le style demande du laiton, du cuivre ou de l’acier nu.), `kit_pe_missiles_sol_masque_equipe.png` (masque_equipe, 256×256, png, required; Liseré dans les zones d’équipe de la base : blanc = liseré gris neutre dans l’albédo, noir = tout le reste.).

## Assembly, UVs and acceptance

Edit only material/image references and PNG pixels in a copy of the delivered base GLB. Preserve its geometry binary, accessors, UVs, skeleton, named nodes and animation clips byte-for-byte; no added ornament geometry.
One shared UV0 layout across LODs and all kits of this base. Preserve material assignments and named attachments. Provide vertex normals and UV0 on every triangle primitive; no negative scale or duplicate node names.
Albedo uses sRGB; normal, roughness, metalness, occlusion and team mask use linear data. Tangent-space normal map follows glTF (+Y/green up). glTF roughness reads G and metalness B; the rugosite PNG stores roughness in G and metalness in B (R may store occlusion). repos: Subtle breathing or scanning; start and end transforms coincide. No root motion.
deplacement: Small suspension or gait motion. The game moves the root; this clip must stay in place and loop seamlessly.
tir: Brief marker-launcher recoil followed by recovery to the working pose; no explosion or projectile mesh.
touche: Small readable tilt and immediate recovery; no damage or missing geometry.

node names, material names, the 2 levels of detail, the team mask, the pivot, the animation clips. Verify every item before delivery. Technical conformance and human visual approval are separate decisions.
